mapper.select: select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, (select count(*) from mst_class_prop p where p.class_type = 'ITEM' and p.class_id = c.class_id and p.use_yn = 'Y') as prop_cnt, (select count(*) from mst_item i where i.item_class_id = c.class_id) as target_cnt from mst_item_class c c.use_yn = #{useYn} order by c.sort_no, c.class_cd
select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, 0 as prop_cnt, 0 as target_cnt from mst_item_class c where c.class_id = #{id}

insert into mst_item_class (comp_cd, class_cd, class_nm, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.classCd}, #{f.classNm}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning class_id

select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, (select count(*) from mst_class_prop p where p.class_type = 'EQUIP' and p.class_id = c.class_id and p.use_yn = 'Y') as prop_cnt, (select count(*) from mst_equip e where e.class_id = c.class_id) as target_cnt from mst_equip_class c order by c.sort_no, c.class_cd

choose.when: from (select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, (select count(*) from mst_class_prop p where p.class_type = 'ITEM' and p.class_id = c.class_id and p.use_yn = 'Y') as prop_cnt, (select count(*) from mst_item i where i.item_class_id = c.class_id) as target_cnt from mst_item_class c c.use_yn = #{useYn}) k
choose.otherwise: from (select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, (select count(*) from mst_class_prop p where p.class_type = 'EQUIP' and p.class_id = c.class_id and p.use_yn = 'Y') as prop_cnt, (select count(*) from mst_equip e where e.class_id = c.class_id) as target_cnt from mst_equip_class c) k

mapper.select:
select k.* order by
k.class_cd k.class_nm k.prop_cnt k.target_cnt k.sort_no
desc,
k.class_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select c.class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, 0 as prop_cnt, 0 as target_cnt from mst_equip_class c where c.class_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: prop_id, class_type, class_id, prop_cd, prop_nm, data_type, unit_nm, scale, options::text as options_json, required_yn, semantic_id, sort_no, use_yn, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: select from mst_class_prop where class_type = #{classType} and class_id = #{classId} and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, prop_cd

insert into mst_class_prop (comp_cd, class_type, class_id, prop_cd, prop_nm, data_type, unit_nm, scale, options, required_yn, semantic_id, sort_no, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.classType}, #{f.classId}, #{f.propCd}, #{f.propNm}, #{f.dataType}, #{f.unitNm}, #{f.scale}, cast(#{f.optionsJson} as jsonb), #{f.requiredYn}, #{f.semanticId}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning prop_id

choose.when: select item_class_id as class_id, attrs::text as attrs, row_ver from mst_item where item_id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: select class_id, attrs::text as attrs, row_ver from mst_equip where equip_id = #{id}
update mst_equip set class_id = #{classId}, attrs = cast(#{attrs} as jsonb), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where equip_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
